name: Phrasly
description_en:
Phrasly combines a document editor, rewriting/humanization, content generation and AI or plagiarism checks. The homepage also presents study tools and a chatbot, so the workflow can involve drafting, editing and checking within one service.

Natural-sounding prose and a detector score are different outputs. The vendor’s pass-rate, watermark and originality claims do not establish authorship, factual correctness or acceptance by an institution; each generated draft still needs a substantive review.
description_zh:
Phrasly 结合文档编辑、改写/自然化、生成及 AI 或抄袭检查，首页另列学习工具和聊天，可在同一服务起草、编辑及检查。

自然表达与检测分数是不同结果，厂商通过率、水印和原创性主张不证明作者身份、事实正确或机构接受，初稿仍需实质审核。

core_features.explanation_en: Develop a draft and revise phrasing in one editor.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在同一编辑器起草并改表达。

core_features.explanation_en: Plagiarism and generated words have limits despite unlimited humanization.
core_features.explanation_zh: 自然化不限量，但抄袭和生成词数有限。

en: Improve report phrasing while preserving figures and attribution.
zh: 改进报告表达并保护数字及归属。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Compare a nonconfidential original and rewrite sentence by sentence before using any score.
steps.zh: 先逐句比较非机密原稿与改稿，再参考分数。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual subscription with separate generation/check limits and paid trial.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: $2 three-day trial with limits; Unlimited $10.99/month billed annually, 5,000 words/process, 50,000 generation and 100,000 plagiarism words/month. FAQ twenty-five credits needs clarification; refund conditional.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 三天试用 $2 且限额；Unlimited 年付折月 $10.99，每次 5,000 词、月生成 50,000/查抄袭 100,000。FAQ 25 额度需澄清，退款有条件。

sources.title: Phrasly: AI Humanizer, AI Detector & AI Chatbot
sources.research_notes_en: Document editor, humanizer, writer, detector and study tools; vendor efficacy/privacy claims not independently validated.

sources.title: Phrasly.AI - Pricing
sources.research_notes_en: $2 three-day access, $10.99/month billed annually, processing and generation/plagiarism limits; conditional comparative refund and FAQ credit discrepancy.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.en: For an illustrative report, preserve figures, attribution, uncertainty and technical terms before changing sentence flow. Compare the rewritten version against the original rather than accepting it because it sounds smoother. A changed hedge or citation can reverse a claim. The platform describes source discovery for generation, but real-time search does not itself validate the resulting reference.
sections.zh: 例如报告，改句式前先保护数字、归属、不确定性和术语，再对照原稿，不能因顺口就接受。限定词或引用变化可反转主张，实时搜索来源也不等于引用正确。

sections.title_en: Read the limits behind the Unlimited plan
sections.title_zh: 阅读 Unlimited 背后的限制
sections.en: The annual-billed card shows $10.99/month, 5,000 words per process, up to 50,000 generated words/month and 100,000 plagiarism-check words/month. Three-day access costs $2 and includes 1,000 humanization words during trial, 800 words/process and up to 6,000 generated words. Renewal amount/timing should be confirmed. The FAQ also says twenty-five generation credits/month, which is not reconciled with the word card.
sections.zh: 年付卡片月 $10.99、每次 5,000 词、月生成最多 50,000 和抄袭检查 100,000 词。三天访问 $2，试期自然化 1,000 词、每次 800、生成最多 6,000，续费金额/时间需确认。FAQ 又称月 25 生成额度，与词数卡片未对齐。

sections.title_en: A conditional refund is not universal detection immunity
sections.title_zh: 有条件退款不是普遍检测豁免
sections.en: The comparative refund asks for a 500-plus-word text, eligible Ultra modes/default settings, a competing public humanizer and results from four named detectors, within fourteen days of payment. It is not a promise that every submission is accepted or future detectors will agree. No detector benchmark, refund or watermark claim was tested.
sections.zh: 比较退款要求 500 词以上、符合 Ultra 模式/默认设置、另一公开工具及四种指定检测结果，付款 14 天内提出；不是保证所有提交获接受或未来检测一致。本文未验证基准、退款或水印主张。

sections.title_zh: 在明确作者责任下改写
sections.en: Phrasly may be evaluated for improving an authorized draft’s clarity, while the author checks factual content and permitted use. Test a short nonconfidential passage with quotations and technical terms. Homepage privacy and in-house-model assertions need contractual confirmation. No editor, API, checker, citation or export was executed; a free-start invitation does not establish a sustained free allowance.
sections.zh: 可用于获允许初稿的清晰度改进，作者负责事实及使用许可。应以含引文和术语的非机密短段试验，首页隐私/自研模型需合同确认。本文未执行编辑器、API、检查、引用或导出，免费开始也不证明持续免费额度。

research_gaps: No detector, plagiarism, originality, watermark, rewrite, refund or API outcome tested.
Renewal price, credit/word reconciliation, sustained-free availability, data contract, license and self-hosting unknown.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
